title: Re-Writing Lapse Days on a Reinstated Named Non-Owner Policy While the Company Stayed Certified
content:
**Principle.** On a Named Non-Owner Policy term reinstated with a lapse, the amount re-written follows the company's exposure during the lapse. Exposure is read from the named insured's SR-22 or FR-44 Operator certificate that was on file during the lapse, as the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) records show. The FR-44 form is read before the SR-22 form. For a form, the filings tried are, in this order, its filed filing recorded first, its cancellation-filed filing recorded first and its terminated filing recorded first; the first of these whose filing date is on or before the first lapse day recorded on the term is the one read. Its **certified-through date** is the earlier of its required-through date and its certificate end date; a date not recorded leaves the other, and there is none when neither is recorded.

1. **Certified throughout.** When the certified-through date is on or after the last lapse day or there is none, the company stayed certified on every lapse day and the whole nonpayment cancellation return is re-written as a flat amount, booked from the cancellation effective date with that return's days as its days.
2. **Certified for part of the lapse.** When the certified-through date is on or after the first lapse day but before the last lapse day, the company stayed certified only through that date. The charged days are the return's days less the lapse days after the certified-through date, those days running from the day after the certified-through date, which is included, to the last lapse day, which is included. The amount re-written is the return multiplied by the charged days and divided by the return's days, booked from the cancellation effective date with the charged days as its days.
3. **Otherwise**, including no such certificate, no lapse day is re-written: the return is re-written by the day from the reinstatement effective date only.

**Illustration (hypothetical: return 300.00 recorded with 150 days; lapse recorded on lapse days 1 to 9, lapse day 1 being the cancellation effective date).**

| Certificate read | Certified-through date | Amount re-written | Entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-44, cancellation filed, filed before lapse day 1; end date after lapse day 9 | after the lapse | 300.00 | from the cancellation effective date, 150 days |
| FR-44, filed, filed before lapse day 1; nothing recorded for either date | none | 300.00 | from the cancellation effective date, 150 days |
| SR-22, filed before lapse day 1; required through lapse day 6, end date later | lapse day 6 | 300.00 multiplied by 147 and divided by 150 = 294.00 | from the cancellation effective date, 147 days |
| FR-44, terminated, filed before lapse day 1; end date before lapse day 1 | before the lapse | by the day from the reinstatement effective date | from the reinstatement effective date |
| only a filing whose filing date is after lapse day 1 | — | by the day from the reinstatement effective date | from the reinstatement effective date |
